decision: Required to start the Race from the pit lane.
fact: The rear wing assembly has been changed while under parc fermé without the approval of the Technical Delegate. Changes to the set up of the suspension were also made.
offence: Breaches of Articles B3.5.3 and B3.5.4 of the FIA F1 Regulations.
penalty: Required to start the Race from the pit lane.
reason: Oracle Red Bull Racing changed the rear wing of Car 30 under parc fermé before the start of the Race, without the approval of the Technical Delegate. This is not in accordance with Article B3.5.4 of the FIA F1 Regulations. The suspension set up was also changed. This is not in accordance with Article B3.5.3 Car 30 is therefore required to start the Race from pit lane as per Article B3.5.3a of the FIA F1 Regulations.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 30 Changes Made Under Parc Ferme
to: The Team Manager, Oracle Red Bull Racing
